name: Outdoor Science School Cabin Leader (Camp Campbell)
what_you_do: Teens mentor students during five-day outdoor science school sessions in the redwoods. They guide activities. They help keep camp safe and fun. Leaders get a full day of training before students arrive.
who_can_apply: Must be at least 15 years old, in 10th grade or higher, and in good academic standing. A High School Authorization Form must be signed by members of your school. No prior training is required, according to the FAQ.
pay_detail: Pay not stated. The page says this is a way to earn Service-Learning credit for graduation.
duration: Five days per session (typically Monday to Friday). Session dates are not stated.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 school year open in August and close in the middle of May. The exact closing date is not stated.
how_to_apply: Complete the online application through the Learn More and Sign Up link, get a High School Authorization Form signed by members of your school, and watch email for further instructions. The page recommends applying at least two weeks before your session dates.
notes: Camp Campbell is at 16275 Highway 9, Boulder Creek, CA 95006, per the cabin-leaders page. This is an unpaid volunteer role, so no work permit is needed. The same YMCA's Youth and Government program is already in ymca-youth-and-government-ca.json. Leaders in Training is also listed on the leadership page, but its age and details are not stated, so it is not a card.
